pressure.title: IGCSE Physics 0625 Pressure Worksheets with Answers, Cambridge IGCSE Physics Printable and Fillable PDF, Physics Teacher Resource
pressure.description:
Print-ready and digital Cambridge IGCSE Physics 0625 Pressure worksheets: p = F/A, force and area in everyday life, pressure in liquids and Δp = ρgΔh.

A complete worksheet pack for Cambridge IGCSE Physics (0625) topic 1.8 Pressure (syllabus for exams from 2026), with fully worked answers and a Cambridge-style mark scheme. Every question is labelled CORE or SUPPLEMENT, so you can set Core-only or Extended work in seconds.

WHAT'S INSIDE (3 FILES)

• Teacher edition PDF (27 pages): teacher notes, syllabus coverage map, one-page knowledge organiser, 3 worksheets, 10 multiple-choice questions, a practical skills question, a revision checklist, a 40-mark exam-style paper, and worked answers with B1/C1/A1 mark points. Click any question number to jump to its answer.
• Student edition PDF (22 pages): the same worksheets and knowledge organiser without answers. Print it, or let students type their answers straight into the PDF on a tablet or computer (fillable answer boxes, plus tick boxes for the multiple-choice answers and the revision checklist)
• Editable Word version: change numbers, wording or question order for your classes

WORKSHEETS

1. Pressure, force and area (Core: p = F/A, unit conversions from cm² and mm², drawing pins, bricks, snowshoes, knives, tractor tyres, foundations)
2. Pressure in liquids (Core: how pressure changes with depth and density, a can with holes, dams, lakes and containers of different shapes)
3. Calculating pressure in liquids (Supplement: Δp = ρgΔh, pools, divers, water towers, layered liquids)

Plus exam-style questions: 40 marks (25 Core, 15 Supplement)

ALSO INCLUDED

• 10 multiple-choice questions in the style of Papers 1 and 2, with an answer key and reasons
• Practical skills question in the style of the Alternative to Practical paper (Paper 6): pressure against depth with a pressure sensor, graph, gradient and density
• Revision checklist so students can track what they know before the exam

WHY TEACHERS LIKE IT

• Area conversions (cm² and mm² to m²) practised step by step, where most marks are lost
• Covers every statement in syllabus section 1.8 (coverage map included)
• Accurate diagrams with dimensions and depth markers
• Worked answers show every step: ideal for self-marking and homework
• Clickable bookmarks in every PDF for quick navigation
• All questions are original, and every answer has been independently checked

INSTANT DIGITAL DOWNLOAD
No physical item will be shipped. After purchase you can download the files straight away from your Etsy account (Purchases and reviews).

LICENCE
For use by the purchasing teacher, tutor or parent and their own students. You may print as many copies as you need for your classes. Please do not share the files or upload them to a website. Schools that want to share the files across a department can buy one copy per teacher.

QUESTIONS?
Message me any time through Etsy. I am a physics teacher with 16 years of experience and I am happy to help.
